envelope.description: Carry the caller's cwd, INSRC_REPO and client in a per-call context

body.title: Carry the caller's cwd, INSRC_REPO and client in a per-call context
body.summary: Add StepCallContext in an AsyncLocalStorage; the daemon-side resolveRepoPath, the code-review handler's repo fallback and directoryOf in src/analyze/context/scope.ts read it inside a call and keep process defaults outside one; the client is held as 'claude' | 'codex' and converted to 'cli-*' only for runWithClientProviderContext in the one-shot analyze.
acceptanceChecks: inside a context, resolveRepoPath, the code-review fallback and directoryOf use the context's cwd and INSRC_REPO, not the process's
outside a context they behave as before
two concurrent contexts never see each other's values

tests.name: resolveRepoPath inside a step.call uses the context's cwd and envRepo, not the process's; outside one it keeps process defaults
scope directoryOf: a bare file name inside a step.call resolves against the context's cwd, and outside one against process.cwd()
client identity: the context holds 'claude' / 'codex'; the code-review deps receive it as is and the one-shot analyze converts it to 'cli-claude' / 'cli-codex'
step context isolation: two concurrent contexts each see their own cwd and client
